sources: In-game mission list and pause-menu statistics
Rockstar Games official GTA III materials
meta.notes: Story mission order follows the in-game sequence. Side missions are listed after the main chain.

items.name: Claude
items.summary: A silent career criminal shot and left for dead by Catalina, who works his way up through Liberty City's underworld to settle the score.

items.name: 8-Ball
items.summary: Frees Claude from the police convoy at the start of the game and runs a bomb shop in Portland.

items.name: Luigi Goterelli
items.summary: Runs Luigi's Sex Club 7 and gives Claude his first paying work in Portland.

items.name: Joey Leone
items.summary: Salvatore's son, based at a Portland garage; assigns car-theft and disposal jobs.

items.name: Toni Cipriani
items.summary: Salvatore's trusted enforcer in Portland. Later the protagonist of Liberty City Stories.

items.name: Salvatore Leone
items.summary: Aging head of the Leone family who takes Claude on before suspecting him of betrayal.

items.name: Maria Latore
items.summary: Salvatore's unpredictable partner, who attaches herself to Claude after leaving the don.

items.name: Asuka Kasen
items.summary: Runs the Yakuza's Staunton Island operations and becomes Claude's main employer after Portland.

items.name: Kenji Kasen
items.summary: Asuka's brother, based at a Staunton casino; assigns jobs against the Triads and Cartel.

items.name: Ray Machowski
items.summary: A dirty cop selling protection and information, eventually forced to flee the city.

items.name: Donald Love
items.summary: A reclusive businessman whose real-estate ambitions involve the Cartel and the Colombian drug trade.

items.name: Catalina
items.summary: Claude's ex-girlfriend who shoots him at the start and later leads the Cartel.

items.name: Miguel
items.summary: Catalina's partner in the Cartel's SPANK drug operation.

items.name: Phil Cassidy
items.summary: One-armed arms dealer operating out of a Portland warehouse.

items.name: El Burro
items.summary: Puerto Rican gang leader in Hepburn Heights who pays in vehicles and cash for chaos.

items.name: King Courtney
items.summary: Jamaican gang boss in Staunton who sets Claude up during a later job.

items.name: D-Ice
items.summary: Wichita Gardens gang leader whose phone missions target the Purple Nines.

items.name: Marty Chonks
items.summary: Runs a dog food factory and asks Claude to dispose of people who threaten him.

items.name: Toni the Tiger
items.summary: A Triad figure involved in the fish factory and Chinatown disputes.

items.name: Give Me Liberty
items.summary: Opening sequence: escape the police convoy with 8-Ball and reach the Portland hideout.

items.name: Luigi's Girls
items.location: Luigi's Sex Club 7, Red Light District
items.summary: Drive Misty to Luigi's club and learn the basics of the Portland job loop.

items.name: Don't Spank Ma Bitch Up
items.summary: Beat up Luigi's abusive client and leave him in the street.

items.name: Drive Misty for Me
items.summary: Chauffeur Misty to a meeting while rivals try to run her off the road.

items.name: Pump-Action Pimp
items.summary: Kill a rival pimp and take his girls off the street.

items.name: The Fuzz Ball
items.summary: Escort two prostitutes past corrupt cops without letting them get arrested.

items.name: Mike Lips Last Lunch
items.summary: Steal Mike Lips' car, rig it with a bomb and return it before he drives off.

items.name: Farewell 'Chunky' Lee Chong
items.summary: Break into a Triad fish factory and kill Chunky Lee Chong with a meat cleaver.

items.name: Van Heist
items.summary: Hijack an armored van and deliver it to Joey's garage intact.

items.name: Cipriani's Chauffeur
items.summary: Drive Toni Cipriani to a sit-down and get him out alive.

items.name: Dead Skunk in the Trunk
items.summary: Dispose of a Triad body in the back of a car before the police find it.

items.name: The Getaway
items.summary: Drive three robbers away from a botched bank job and lose the cops.

items.name: Taking Out the Laundry
items.summary: Destroy three Triad laundry vans without wrecking your own ride.

items.name: The Pickup
items.summary: Collect a protection payment from a Triad laundry and survive the ambush.

items.name: Salvatore's Called a Meeting
items.summary: Pick up the Leone capos from the airport and bring them to Salvatore's mansion.

items.name: Triads and Tribulations
items.summary: Wipe out a Triad meeting in Chinatown.

items.name: Blow Fish
items.summary: Destroy the Triad fish factory using a truck bomb.

items.name: Cutting the Grass
items.summary: Follow a suspected informant and eliminate him without being seen.

items.name: Bomb da Base: Act I
items.summary: Snipe the Cartel guards on the freighter to clear the way for the bombing run.

items.name: Bomb da Base: Act II
items.summary: Plant eight bombs on the Cartel freighter while under fire.

items.name: Last Requests
items.summary: Salvatore turns on Claude; escape the mansion ambush and leave Portland.

items.name: Sayonara Salvatore
items.summary: Assassinate Salvatore Leone outside his own club.

items.name: Under Surveillance
items.summary: Kill the Cartel men watching Asuka's construction site.

items.name: Paparazzi Purge
items.summary: Take out a photographer who has compromising pictures of Asuka.

items.name: Payday for Ray
items.summary: Collect Ray Machowski's bribe money and shake off the tail he sent.

items.name: Two-Faced Tanner
items.summary: Kill an undercover cop who is following Ray.

items.name: Kanbu Bust-out
items.summary: Break a Yakuza associate out of police custody.

items.name: Grand Theft Auto
items.summary: Steal three specific cars for Kenji's showroom.

items.name: Deal Steal
items.summary: Ambush a Cartel drug deal and take the cash.

items.name: Shima
items.summary: Protect Kenji during a meeting with a Triad boss.

items.name: Smack Down
items.summary: Kill eight SPANK dealers across Staunton before time runs out.

items.name: Silence the Sneak
items.summary: Kill a witness before he reaches the courthouse.

items.name: Arms Shortage
items.summary: Defend Phil Cassidy's warehouse from a Cartel raid.

items.name: Evidence Dash
items.summary: Destroy a police vehicle carrying evidence against Ray.

items.name: Gone Fishing
items.summary: Kill a cop who is about to testify, then escape by boat.

items.name: Plaster Blaster
items.summary: Ambush a police convoy and destroy the armored van.

items.name: Liberator
items.summary: Rescue an undercover operative from a Cartel stronghold.

items.name: Waka-Gashira Wipeout!
items.summary: Kill Kenji Kasen while disguised as a Cartel gunman to start a gang war.

items.name: A Drop in the Ocean
items.summary: Pick up a floating package dropped by plane and deliver it to Love.

items.name: Grand Theft Aero
items.summary: Steal a plane from the airport and deliver it to Love's contact.

items.name: Escort Service
items.summary: Escort a Securicar full of evidence through Cartel roadblocks.

items.name: Decoy
items.summary: Survive a Cartel assault while a decoy convoy draws them off.

items.name: Love's Disappearance
items.summary: Find out why Donald Love has vanished from his own building.

items.name: Bait
items.summary: Use yourself as bait to draw three Cartel kill-squads into the open.

items.name: Espresso-2-Go!
items.summary: Destroy all SPANK stands across the three islands before the Cartel expands.

items.name: S.A.M.
items.summary: Destroy the Cartel seaplane delivering a drug shipment.

items.name: Ransom
items.summary: Deliver a ransom and survive the Cartel trap.

items.name: The Exchange
items.summary: Final mission: assault Catalina's Cartel base and rescue Maria.

items.name: Turismo
items.summary: Win an illegal street race through Portland.

items.name: I Scream, You Scream
items.summary: Use an ice cream van to kill a rival gang member.

items.name: Trial by Fire
items.summary: Kill 25 Diablos within a time limit using a flamethrower.

items.name: Bling-Bling Scramble
items.summary: Collect 15 packages in a Yardie gang car within the time limit.

items.name: Kingdom Come
items.summary: Drive a car rigged with a bomb to a Yardie target.

items.name: Uzi Rider
items.summary: Kill 20 Purple Nines with an Uzi.

items.name: Gangcar Round-up
items.summary: Steal three gang cars and deliver them to D-Ice.

items.name: The Crook
items.summary: Kill a thief who tried to rob Marty's factory.

items.name: The Wife
items.summary: Dispose of Marty's wife after she discovers his operation.

codes.code: R2 R2 L1 R1 L2 L2 L2 L1

codes.code: TIME FLIES BY WHEN YOU'RE DRIVING

items.name: Liberty City
items.summary: The game's setting: three islands modelled on New York City.

items.name: Portland
items.summary: Industrial starting island with the Leone heartland and the docks.

items.name: Staunton Island
items.summary: Commercial and financial island, unlocked after Last Requests.

items.name: Shoreside Vale
items.summary: Suburban island with the airport, dam and Cochrane Dam finale.

items.name: Saint Mark's
items.summary: Leone family stronghold and Salvatore's mansion.

items.name: Red Light District
items.summary: Luigi's Sex Club 7 and the early mission hub.

items.name: Chinatown
items.summary: Triad territory and the fish factory.

items.name: Hepburn Heights
items.summary: Diablos territory and El Burro's base.

items.name: Trenton
items.summary: Industrial district with Marty Chonks' dog food factory.

items.name: Harwood
items.summary: Industrial area near the Callahan Bridge.

items.name: Bedford Point
items.summary: Downtown district with the Liberty Tree offices.

items.name: Belleville Park
items.summary: Central park area of Staunton.

items.name: Torrington
items.summary: Business district and Asuka's construction site.

items.name: Cedar Grove
items.summary: Affluent hillside district with the Cartel mansion.

items.name: Pike Creek
items.summary: Residential area near the dam.

items.name: Wichita Gardens
items.summary: Housing projects and Red Jacks territory.

items.name: Cochrane Dam
items.summary: The dam where the final mission takes place.

items.name: Francis International Airport
items.summary: Airport used in A Drop in the Ocean and S.A.M.
